name: film-grain-vignette
title: Film grain and vignette
description: A full-frame finishing overlay: a soft dark vignette at the edges and fine animated film grain that changes 12 times a second, both faint enough to keep text readable. Put it on the top track over the whole video; set Length to the clip's data-duration and Strength between 0 and 1.

variables.label: Length in seconds (0: match the clip)
